description: This file defines API endpoints for managing user preferences in Mattermost, including retrieving, updating, and deleting preferences with permission checks.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API struct for handling preference-related routes

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Context object encapsulating request, response, and session info

methods.name: InitPreference
methods.description: Initializes preference API routes with handlers for get, update, delete, and category-specific preferences

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Handles retrieving preferences for a user, with permission checks

methods.name: getPreferencesByCategory
methods.description: Retrieves preferences filtered by category for a user

methods.name: getPreferenceByCategoryAndName
methods.description: Retrieves a specific preference by category and name for a user

methods.name: updatePreferences
methods.description: Updates user preferences with validation and permission checks

methods.name: deletePreferences
methods.description: Deletes specified user preferences with permission validation
